en: Abu al-Tayyib Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Mutanabbi
ar: أبو الطيب أحمد بن الحسين المتنبي

description.tr: Tarihin en çok alıntılanan Arap şairi — 'şiirin peygamberi' olarak anılır. Methiyeleri ve felsefi dizeleri Arap edebiyat başarısının altın standardı olmaya devam eder || Mütenebbî, altın çağında Halep'teki Hamdani sarayında hizmet etti. || [Tarih notu] Blachère'in 1935 çalışması standart Batı kritik analizi olmaya devam eder.
description.en: Most quoted Arabic poet in history — called 'the prophet of poetry' (hence his name, 'one who claims prophecy'). His panegyrics and philosophical verses remain the gold standard of Arabic literary achievement || Mutanabbi served at the Hamdanid court of Sayf al-Dawla in Aleppo during its golden age. His qaṣā'id (odes) combine philosophical depth with verbal pyrotechnics. Source material notes he was 'killed at age 50' — assassinated while fleeing Baghdad after a dispute. His poetry has generated more commentary than any other Arabic poet. || [Historiographical note] Blachère's 1935 study remains the standard Western critical analysis. Mutanabbi's verse is the most commented-upon corpus in Arabic literature — over 40 known commentaries exist.
description.ar: أكثر شاعر عربي اقتباسًا في التاريخ — لُقّب 'نبي الشعر'. قصائده في المديح والفلسفة لا تزال المعيار الذهبي للأدب العربي || خدم المتنبي في بلاط سيف الدولة الحمداني في حلب. قصائده تجمع بين العمق الفلسفي والبراعة اللفظية. قُتل وهو في الخمسين
